filters.label: Filters
filters.bloodTypeHint: Show requests for any of the selected types.
filters.rangeError: “To” must be on or after “From”. Requests can’t be posted in the future.
filters.nearNote: “Near me” uses your location only in this browser to sort results. It’s never sent with your account.

results.privacyNote: Locations are generalized to the city or an authorized facility. Details can change — always follow each request’s coordination steps.
results.showingFrom: Showing results from {{time}}. Statuses may have changed.
results.offlineBody: We’ll retry automatically when your connection returns.

map.label: Map of blood requests
map.expiredHidden: Expired requests aren’t shown on the map
map.closedHidden: Closed requests aren’t shown on the map
map.locateFailedBody: Check your browser’s location permission. You can still search by city or municipality.

detail.title: {{type}} blood requested
detail.notice: BloodMap shares coordination details only. It doesn’t confirm that blood is still needed or that you can donate — qualified staff at the facility decide eligibility.

respond.title: How to respond
respond.step1: Contact the coordination point below during desk hours.
respond.step2: Mention request ID {{id}} so staff can match your response.
respond.step3: Staff screen every donor on-site. Follow their guidance — not this page — on whether you can donate.

point.gated: Desk contact details are shown to signed-in users only.

detail.reviewNote: Submitted details reviewed by a coordinator on {{when}}. This confirms the listing, not medical information.

expired.title: No longer accepting responses
expired.body: It reached its expiry on {{date}} at {{time}} without a coordinator update. Please don’t contact the facility about this request.

closed.title: No further responses needed
closed.body: A coordinator closed this request on {{date}}. Please don’t contact the facility about it.

notFound.title: This request isn’t available
notFound.body: It may have been removed from public view. Look for active requests nearby instead.

detail.savedToastBody: You’ll see updates in Saved requests.
detail.saveFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.
